label: PF Backlog 576
title: Defect: durable-state checkpoint opens conflicting PRs (stale base; no cleanup) -> runtime work-state never reaches develop and drifts
body: core/state_checkpoint.checkpoint (BI-PF-1257) creates the state branch from v.base_ref('develop') WITHOUT fetching first, so the branch is based on a STALE origin/develop; the copied durable files then conflict with the advanced origin/develop. _land_via_pr returns on merge failure without closing the PR/branch, so a stray conflicting '[data] periodic durable-state checkpoint' PR is left behind. Net: the runtime tree's durable state (items/provenance/indexes) never lands on develop and keeps diverging. RCCA: fetch the integration ref before basing the worktree; on merge failure, update-branch and retry once, else close the PR + delete the branch (no stray PRs).

objective: Make the durable-state checkpoint land reliably on develop: base the state branch on a FRESH origin/develop and never leave a conflicting PR behind.
acceptance_criteria: checkpoint fetches origin before creating the state worktree (fresh base)
on merge failure it retries via pr update-branch once, then closes the PR+branch (no stray PRs)
a checkpoint after a fresh fetch lands cleanly (no conflict)
out_of_scope: the runtime-tree one-time sync (separate ops step after this lands)
approach: Add v.fetch() before add_worktree; in _land_via_pr, on non-zero merge, pr update-branch + retry once, then pr close --delete-branch and return the reason.
verification: Objective achieved: Defect: durable-state checkpoint opens conflicting PRs (stale base; no cleanup) -> runtime work-state never reaches develop and drifts
risks: closing a PR on failure must only happen for the checkpoint's own state branch
